findings.title: Finite media remain subordinate to the Lord's words
findings.claim: The sea, ink, added supply, and matched replenishment form a finite chain of media: multiplying the carrier can extend transmission, but the Lord's words remain beyond the carrier's exhaustion.
findings.mechanism: The focus assigns the sea a writing-medium role, places depletion before the words, and adds a like supply; the supplied 31:27 parallel returns through multiplied seas and divine words, while 18:27 returns through the Lord-and-words relation as an unalterable source.
findings.reader_payoff: The comparison becomes a limit on media rather than a limit on source content: more carriers can increase inscription capacity without enclosing what they carry.
findings.containment: This is a global resonance of the supplied sea-and-ink conditional. It does not claim every m-d-d branch is active, infer target morphology missing from the connection rows, or turn the image into a quantitative theory of communication.

epistemic.reason: A trusted citable publication supplies the core relation and legacy activations corroborate it, while the connection rows provide exact target Arabic but qualify their target morphology as unavailable.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.
branch_activations.carrier: The possessive Lord term attached to both word constructions carries the ownership and governing-authority relation.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 18:27 connection directly pairs the Book with the Lord and states that His words cannot be altered.
branch_activations.activation: The same-surah return makes the possessive Lord a source-and-authority relation for the words rather than a generic human possessor.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The words are source-governed content, while the sea remains a medium that can be used up.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the focus's possessive construction under the core ownership facet; it does not apply the absolute-name facet to every occurrence of رَبّ.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Temel işlem, bir şeyi boyuna çekip uzunluğunu veya yayılımını artırarak uzatmak ya da bağlantılı hâle getirmektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The added-supply noun can carry the root's extension and increased-spread pressure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 31:27 connection supplies multiplied seas after the first sea in the same medium comparison.
branch_activations.activation: The focus's added amount contacts the wider image as an extension of a finite carrier, not as an extension of the source words.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The matched addition enlarges the medium's capacity while leaving the source outside that enlargement.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not import the branch's time, shadow, or bodily-length uses.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, bir alıcıya dışarıdan yardım, kaynak veya miktar ekleyerek onu desteklemek ve sürdürmektir.
branch_activations.carrier: The final m-d-d form names an added amount that can support and sustain the sea-as-medium premise.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 31:27 target describes additional seas supplying the first sea in the same inexhaustibility image.
branch_activations.activation: The added amount contacts the replenishment relation as an external resource entering a finite carrier.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: A carrier may be supported from outside and still remain exhaustible relative to the words it carries.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not activate the branch's military, food, or ordinary human-support applications.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: suyun akıp çoğalması ve başka sudan beslenmesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Su kaynağının akması, dolması ve su miktarının artması dalın temel durumudur.
branch_activations.carrier: The final m-d-d form can carry an increase and filling of a water source.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 31:27 connection's exact target Arabic and note present multiplied seas as the replenishing image.
branch_activations.activation: The added supply contacts the water-growth branch through the wider sea-feeding-sea parallel.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Even a replenished water medium belongs to the finite side of the comparison and can be exhausted before the words.
branch_activations.boundary: This is limited to the supplied water-fed trigger and does not make the ordinary m-d-d root a general water meaning here.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: suyun akıp çoğalması ve başka sudan beslenmesi
branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir nehir, kuyu veya denizin başka bir su kaynağı tarafından beslenip suyunun artırılması özel bir gerçekleşmedir.
branch_activations.carrier: The added amount is the focus's explicit matched supply attached to the sea-medium comparison.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 31:27 target names a sea supplied by seven further seas, as recorded in the connection note.
branch_activations.activation: The exact counterpart in the focus contacts the specialized water-source relation in the wider parallel.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Adding another sea can multiply the medium without changing the words into a finite stock.
branch_activations.boundary: The activation does not extend to unrelated natural-water or plant-flow uses of the branch.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yazı sıvısı ve hokkadan kaleme aktarılması
branch_activations.facet_statement: Kalemin iz bırakmasını sağlayan yazı sıvısı, dalın nesne çekirdeğidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus's midād form carries the writing liquid assigned to the sea.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 31:27 connection joins multiplied seas to pens in a near-verbatim inexhaustibility parallel.
branch_activations.activation: The wider pen-and-sea image returns through the focus's writing-medium noun and makes the medium function concrete.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The sea is a writing supply whose multiplication still cannot contain the words being written.
branch_activations.boundary: This activates the ink object facet only; it does not import the hokka-renewal or pen-dipping associated facets.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyin içindekilerin ya da varlığının tükenmesiyle artık kalmaması.
branch_activations.carrier: The intransitive exhaustion verb is assigned first to the sea and then tested against the Lord's words.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 31:27 repeats multiplied seas against unexhausted divine words, and 16:96 contrasts what humans exhaust with what remains with Allah.
branch_activations.activation: The wider finite-versus-source contrast returns through both focus occurrences of the depletion verb.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The medium's contents can run out while the words remain outside the condition of depletion.
branch_activations.boundary: This keeps the focus's intransitive depletion and does not activate the transitive consume-or-finish branch.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Tükenmenin o şeyin sürekliliğini kesip sona erdirmesi.
branch_activations.carrier: The focus marks the sea's continuity as breakable before it denies the same ending to the words.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The supplied parallels repeat the boundary between exhaustible human media and what remains with Allah.
branch_activations.activation: The wider contrast makes the order of endings itself semantically active: the carrier stops first, not the source-content.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The comparison exposes a discontinuity between a medium's finite duration and the words' continuing source relation.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim an abstract theory of eternity beyond the supplied exhaustion contrast.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek, tek başına anlam taşıyan bir harf veya harflerden oluşmuş tek bir söz birimidir.
branch_activations.carrier: The repeated kalimāt forms carry meaningful verbal units as the content assigned to the ink-medium.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 31:27 repeats the multiplied-medium comparison against divine words, and 18:27 returns to the Lord's words as unalterable.
branch_activations.activation: The wider word-and-medium parallels make the focus's words the content being carried rather than another material quantity inside the sea.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Meaningful word content exceeds the finite carrier that records or transmits it.
branch_activations.boundary: This uses the word-unit core only and does not claim that every k-l-m branch is active.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çoğul biçimler söz birimlerinin toplamını gösterir; bunlardan biri en az üç söz birimini kapsar.
branch_activations.carrier: The plural word form presents a field of meaningful units rather than a single material object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 31:27 places multiplied seas opposite the plural divine words in the same inexhaustibility construction.
branch_activations.activation: The wider parallel returns through the focus plural and makes the contrast scale-bearing: many media still do not bound the word field.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The plurality of words remains semantically open even as the material supports are multiplied.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not infer a count or inventory of the words from the plural form.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Tanrı'ya bağlanan söz ve söylenen söz tamlamaları, kaynakta ayrıca adlandırılan ve yalnız bu kuruluşlara bağlı kullanımlardır.
branch_activations.carrier: The words are explicitly constructed with the Lord as their possessor in the focus.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: 18:27 repeats the Lord-and-words construction and states that His words cannot be altered.
branch_activations.activation: The same-surah relation returns through the divine-word construction and ties the non-exhaustion claim to its stated source.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The material medium is bounded because it serves words attributed to the Lord, not because the source-content is another finite object.
branch_activations.boundary: This retains the construction-specific facet and does not generalize it to every use of the k-l-m root.

branch_activations.facet_statement: İki şey arasında benzerlik, denklik veya eşitlik ilişkisi kurulur; eylem kullanımında bu ilişki konuşan tarafından açıkça kurulabilir.
branch_activations.carrier: The coda's mithlihi carries the finite sea's matched counterpart or equivalent.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The 17:88 connection supplies an exact likeness challenge and notes that the focus's divine speech lies beyond creaturely equivalence.
branch_activations.activation: The global likeness return distinguishes adding a counterpart to a finite medium from producing a counterpart to the divine words.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Even an exact matched addition remains on the carrier side of the comparison; the source-content is not enclosed by creaturely equivalence.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not replace the local referent of the pronoun or claim that 18:109 itself is a separate imitation challenge.

friction_notes: The HFT source is visible but legacy_unbound: its seven assigned records have zero supplied anchor evidence, so none can provide a focus-return activation.
The global connection rows supply exact target Arabic but explicitly withhold target morphology; the accepted finding keeps that qualification visible.
The 18:110 retrospective claims remain outside the finding because the packet supplies no citable context unit or exact focus-word return for them.
